cards.title: Invert, always invert
cards.prompt: List 3 things that would guarantee this idea fails. Now flip each one into a rule you will follow.

cards.title: And then what?
cards.prompt: Say the idea works. Write what happens next after 10 days, 10 months and 10 years. Look for one surprise.

cards.title: Five Whys
cards.prompt: Write why you want this idea. Ask "why?" five times in a row. Does the last answer point to a better idea?

cards.title: Force field
cards.prompt: List what pushes this idea forward and what holds it back. Pick one push to make stronger and one block to remove.

cards.title: Thought experiment
cards.prompt: Imagine you launched this a year ago. Write the one-paragraph story of how it went. What did you learn that you can use today?

cards.title: Shrink the wait
cards.prompt: Value goes up when the wait and the effort go down. How could a buyer get the result twice as fast, with half the work? Name 2 changes.

cards.title: Problems into solutions
cards.prompt: List every problem a buyer hits before, during and after buying. Turn 3 of them into a named "How to..." bonus.

cards.title: Make a true guarantee
cards.prompt: Finish this honestly: "If you don't get ___ in ___ days, I will ___." What would you need to change so you could keep that promise?

cards.title: Find the starving crowd
cards.prompt: Who wants this most, right now, and can pay? Describe that one person in 2 sentences. Where do they hang out?

cards.title: Sell while you sleep
cards.prompt: Code and media are leverage that needs no one's permission. What could you make once (a video, a guide, a tool) that keeps selling this idea for you?

cards.title: Play that feels like work
cards.prompt: What feels like play to you but work to other people? Mix that skill into this idea. What changes?

cards.title: Can't decide? No.
cards.prompt: Write the one version of this idea you would say a clear "yes" to. Cut everything you feel only "maybe" about.

cards.title: Anti-vision
cards.prompt: Write 3 sentences about your life in 3 years if this idea never happens. Make it uncomfortable. Then write one sentence about the life you want instead.

cards.title: You are the niche
cards.prompt: What problem have you already solved for yourself? How could this idea sell that solution to people one step behind you?

cards.title: Big goal to today
cards.prompt: Turn this idea into one big goal. Then write a goal for this year, this month, this week and today.

cards.title: The one important question
cards.prompt: In one sentence: why would customers come to you instead of where they go now? "Better quality" or "better service" does not count.

cards.title: Give more, charge the same
cards.prompt: What could you add that costs you little but makes this clearly better at the same price? What makes that possible for you and not others?

cards.title: The X factor
cards.prompt: Name one surprise no research would catch (a new law, a copycat, a bad season). What would you do on day one if it happened?

cards.title: Own a system
cards.prompt: Which part of this still needs you every single time? How could it run without you: a product, a system, or a helper?

cards.title: You're in marketing
cards.prompt: You are not in the product business. You are in the marketing business. Write 3 ways people will hear about this idea this week.

cards.title: Asset or liability?
cards.prompt: Will this idea put money in your pocket every month, or take it out? Redesign it so it becomes an income-producing asset.

cards.title: Biggest mistakes hook
cards.prompt: Write a free lead magnet title: "The (#) Biggest Mistakes (who) Make When (doing what)." Write 3 versions.

cards.title: Give away the best bite
cards.prompt: Make the full thing in your head. What is its single best small piece you could give away free to start an email list?

cards.title: Free list first
cards.prompt: Before paying for ads: name 3 podcasts, groups or blogs where you could show up for free and point people to your offer.

cards.title: 100 customers in 100 days
cards.prompt: You must get 100 customers in 100 days or close. Who are your first 10, and how do you reach them this week?

cards.title: Offer, not commodity
cards.prompt: Swap the plain product for an offer people want: a free assessment, a 14-day challenge, a class. What is yours called?

cards.title: Teach first
cards.prompt: Plan a free 30-minute class or video that teaches something useful and leads into your idea. What are its 3 main points?

cards.title: The 4 U's
cards.prompt: Write a headline for this idea. Score it 1-4 on urgent, unique, ultra-specific and useful. Rewrite until at least 3 score 3 or more.

cards.title: So what?
cards.prompt: List 3 features. After each one ask "so what?" until you reach the real reason someone would buy.

cards.title: Beliefs, feelings, desires
cards.prompt: Write what your buyer believes, feels and wants about this problem. Which line surprises you?

cards.title: I will act now
cards.prompt: What is one step you can take in the next 10 minutes? Write it down, then go do it before you draw another card.

cards.title: Persist until I succeed
cards.prompt: Every "no" brings you closer to a "yes". Name 5 people you could ask about this idea today.

cards.title: Multiply by a hundred
cards.prompt: Write your best realistic goal for this idea. Now write it 100 times bigger. What would you have to do differently?

cards.title: Next action
cards.prompt: What is the very next physical, visible step? If it takes less than 2 minutes, do it now.

cards.title: Brainstorm without judging
cards.prompt: Picture wild success. Write 10 ways to get there in 3 minutes. Don't judge any of them until the list is done.

cards.title: Someday or now?
cards.prompt: Is this idea a project you'll move this month, or a someday/maybe? If it's now, name the outcome and one next action.

cards.title: Come in from the side
cards.prompt: Direct pushes meet resistance. How could you reach buyers through a partner, a third party or a door no one else uses?

cards.title: The reversal
cards.prompt: When would this idea be the wrong move? Name the sign that should make you stop or change course.

cards.title: Lose a battle, win the war
cards.prompt: What small loss could you accept now (time, a sale, pride) to win the bigger goal later?

constraints: You only have 1 hour a week.
It has to work from your phone.
It must work in a small town.
Someone else must do the work.
It has to be free for the user.
You can only sell to businesses.
Combine it with gardening or plants.
Combine it with a church or community group.
Combine it with a game or contest.
It must be done in person, face to face.
